about: A set of extra Git commands for everyday chores, like squashing branches and summing up a repo.

prs.title: Squash leaves unfinished edits alone
prs.broken: git squash also swept in any edited file you had not staged, putting half-done work into the commit.
prs.changed: It now commits only what is staged.
prs.matters: Work in progress stays out of the squashed commit.
